name: WF3 - New Offer → AI Moderation (Claude) → Admin

parameters.query:
SELECT o.id AS offer_id, o.title, o.description, o.conditions, o.discount_type, o.discount_value,
       o.start_date, o.end_date, b.id AS business_id, b.name AS business_name
FROM offers o
JOIN businesses b ON b.id = o.business_id
WHERE o.id = $1
LIMIT 1;
